card.name: Digits right after a comma in numbers
card.fires_on: The digit or letter that comes right after a comma inside a number, such as the 0 in 25,000 or the 1 in a list like 5, 10, 15. Also fires on a letter after a comma in a list.

modes.label: Digit after thousands comma
modes.description: A zero right after a comma that starts a thousands group in a count or dose.

modes.label: Digit in a number list
modes.description: The first digit of the next number in a comma-separated list of amounts.

card.plain: It marks the spot just after a comma inside a written number, where the next digits come.
